name: Configuration-only empirical bundle
fields: max_close_factor; liquidation ratios; liquidation penalties; initial prices; target debt shares; reviewed scalar thresholds
modules: configuration loader; experiments; existing config classes
required_tests: schema, units, exact-ilk mapping, established baseline regression
stop_conditions: Withheld FTX is validation only; stop if any field needs mechanics changes.
backward_compatibility: Existing defaults and Experiments 1–5 remain unchanged unless empirical config is selected.

name: Distribution-aware vault initialisation
fields: debt and collateral-ratio joint distributions; collateral-specific pools
modules: vault.py; simulation.py; collateral.py; new optional schema adapter
required_tests: support, tails, dependence, seed, small-ilk fallback and ETH-only equivalence
stop_conditions: Stop if empirical pools are too small or generated states violate invariants.
backward_compatibility: Global Gaussian path remains the default fallback.

name: Empirical market and gas sampling
fields: aligned moving blocks; regime-labelled gas distributions; gas units and prices
required_tests: block boundaries, correlation, seeds, zero-gas exclusion and unit reconciliation
stop_conditions: Stop if hourly frequency or gas-unit conversion is ambiguous.
backward_compatibility: GBM and scalar gas paths remain supported.

name: Liquidation demand and throughput separation
fields: optional hurdle demand; capacity scalar/distribution; minimum-profit threshold
required_tests: liquidatable/Bark/grab/Take distinctions, backlog, capacity and profit tests
stop_conditions: Stop if endogenous liquidatability is double-counted.
backward_compatibility: Deterministic capacity and current one-stage liquidation remain available.

name: Confidence and behavioural calibration
fields: 15 simulation-calibration controls; confidence, panic, arbitrage and recovery
required_tests: SMM/minimum-distance, ablation, sensitivity and withheld FTX validation
stop_conditions: Stop if FTX enters fitting or latent coefficients are presented as direct estimates.
backward_compatibility: Existing hand-set behaviour remains the reference baseline.
